game.name: ASHVALE
game.description: New in 0.8.151: the great mountain with its two ways up, camps and fingerposts; the Frostspire wizard tower on the summit with its quests and the wizard cloak; mountain goats; fences and boulders along the roads; night versions of every music track. From 0.8.150: petting your dog no longer leaves you stuck, and pets stand on the ground on slopes. From 0.8.149: Inspect shows your dog's own picture with its traits, and pets stay inside with you upstairs. From 0.8.148: your pet dog stays in a ring round you on Heel, roams, runs, sits and lies down on Play (two dogs on Play play together), and you can pet it. From 0.8.147: sheep in the fields, and a soundtrack with its own music for each area (a Music tab picks the track). From 0.8.146: the Lake Castle's court - a throne room, banquet hall, gardens and fountains, and a royal family with errands for you. From 0.8.145: fishing all along the Lake Castle's waters, and a bridge you walk on. From 0.8.144: the Lake Castle at full size on East Lake, about 450 m north-east of Ashvale over a torch-lit bridge, with a farm, windmill, chapel, market and four new quests. From 0.8.143: the Lake Castle stands north-east of Ashvale, over a river and a bridge; fallen town guards drop loot; the dragon offers Talk-to first. From 0.8.142: hold a Doginal Dog or an Anti Doginal Dog in your Dogecoin wallet and that dog walks at your heel as a pet; long-press it to choose which, or to see anyone's number and traits. From 0.8.141: GOLD put in a Fortune Engine while the Bank could not be reached comes back to your pack by itself, and a spin the Bank never answers frees the machine. From 0.8.140: a wallet with more than 500 pieces is read in full, so no item goes missing from your pack or chest. From 0.8.139: GOLD moves at once between your pack, your chest and the Fortune Engines; a cash-out over 20,000 keeps 20,000 in your pack and puts the rest in your chest; dropping GOLD uses the chest's number pad. From 0.8.135: dropping GOLD asks how much, and a Fortune Engine cash-out over 10,000 GOLD goes straight to your chest. From 0.8.130: stand up from a Fortune Engine and your GOLD is back in your pack at once. From 0.8.129: Fortune Engine credit shows the moment you put GOLD in, and at the card table the turn always passes to the next player round from the one who acted. From 0.8.128: four Fortune Engines in the Saltmere Tap's card room upstairs, steel cabinets with mechanical reels made by a master smith and a wizard. Sit on the bench, put GOLD in the coin slot, pick a wager from 1 to 300 and pull the lever; the @ashvale Bank keeps your credit and sends it home when you stand up. From 0.8.127, by sadfrogltc: the Heart Below dungeon is rebuilt and the dragon fight reworked, three quests are back, and Cinder's deer are home north of the wall. From 0.8.126: chess moves show in the chat. From 0.8.124: a table played for GOLD asks before you sit. From 0.8.123: your @handle is your name, everywhere. Ziibiing's land is there the moment you arrive. And from 0.8.120: each home has its own chest. What you put in a Ziibiing chest stays in Ziibiing's chests, what you put in an Ashvale chest stays in Ashvale's, and anything new from the arcade shows in both until you take it. Gold still on its way from the Bank counts in your chest at once. Chess pieces no longer jump back after a move, the card table shows all five board cards in a row, and ASHVALE has its own tab icon. ASHVALE is free to play: knights, wizards and archers, the Saltmere Tap's card room upstairs, the Chess Park, and the Ojibwe village of Ziibiing on the far continent.
